user.title: Connect to litra-agent
user.description: Enter the address of the computer running litra-agent.

pair.title: Pair with litra-agent
pair.description:
Run `litra-agent pair` on the computer at {host}. Check that the fingerprint it prints matches this one exactly, then enter its token.

`{fingerprint}`

If the fingerprints differ, stop: something else is answering at this address.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair with litra-agent
reauth_confirm.description:
The agent rejected Home Assistant's credentials. Run `litra-agent pair` on the agent's computer and enter the new token.

Certificate fingerprint ({status}):

`{fingerprint}`

Confirm it matches the `litra-agent pair` output before continuing.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach litra-agent at that address.
error.fingerprint_changed: The agent's certificate changed during setup. Start again.
error.unsupported_version: This litra-agent speaks an API version this integration doesn't support. Update one or the other.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered agent didn't advertise an ID.
abort.wrong_agent: A different litra-agent answered at that address.
